description: Searches the 21,611 APIs and MCP servers indexed by AgentSLA by keyword and/or category. Use it first to find candidate services; then get_api_details for one listing, or check_endpoint to test a URL live. Free, read-only, served from the index (no live probing). Returns totalIndexed, matchedCount and up to `limit` listings, each with id, service_name, endpoint_url, category, link_type ("api" = callable endpoint, "listing-page" = a directory page about the service, "spec-file" = an API description file) and current_sla_score (share of recent probes that answered, null if never probed). Callable APIs come first. When a category matches nothing, availableCategories lists the valid ones.

callableOnly.description: true returns only callable endpoints (link_type "api"), skipping directory pages and spec files.

category.description: Category slug: mcp-connectors, ai-models, data-retrieval, autonomous-agents, cloud, developer_tools, web3-rpc, image-generation, security, financial, marketing, analytics, ecommerce, iot, payment, defi-data. Display names such as "Web3 RPC" or "LLM Inference & AI Models" also work. Omit for all categories.

search.description: Keywords matched against service name and URL, e.g. "weather", "stripe", "solana rpc". Omit to browse a category.

name: discover_monitored_apis
title: Search the API directory
